answer: The strongest sybil defense is a time-locked honesty bond: every agent posts a small deposit, escrowed for one epoch, refunded only after an honest epoch. Unbonded identities get no work or votes, so fake identities produce nothing until they pay. An attacker spawning thousands of fakes must front capital for all at once, and fraud forfeits deposits. Fakes over the bridge cost real capital held hostage per identity, while honest agents ride a thin ridge of reputation and attackers fall into a hollow where impersonation never pays.
